tasks.objective: Produce physical proof of Task A -> verified result -> automatic Task B on real Muse with zero human relay.
tasks.acceptance: Two real consecutive Muse tasks complete with durable identity/evidence and no human prompt between them.

tasks.objective: Identify one canonical scheduler/runtime path and eliminate duplicate architectural authority.
tasks.acceptance: One authority map; duplicate schedulers explicitly excluded; minimal integration order documented.

tasks.objective: Physically prove restart/resume without duplicate side effects or lost RESULT_READY.
tasks.acceptance: Controlled restart preserves identity and terminal result; ambiguous STARTED is not replayed.

tasks.objective: Create local reproducible benchmark harness comparing Courier and a single-agent baseline on identical task sets.
tasks.acceptance: Outputs machine-readable metrics for verified tasks/hour, human relays, duplicates, lost results, result-to-next latency and tool calls.

tasks.objective: Run safe scale canaries 1->4->8->16 under host resource governors.
tasks.acceptance: Every stage has admission evidence, zero writer conflicts, zero unowned processes and persisted results.

tasks.objective: Expose real demo telemetry from canonical state without creating a second scheduler.
tasks.acceptance: Dashboard/projection shows logical slots, active workers, tasks completed, auto-next count, human relays, duplicates, lost results and runtime.

tasks.objective: Run bounded 60-120+ minute Vacation Mode soak and retain evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Repeated RESULT->VERIFY->NEXT transitions with no human relay except real gates.

tasks.objective: Identify one workflow where durable verified continuation has measurable customer value.
tasks.acceptance: One narrow pilot hypothesis with baseline, acceptance metric and willingness-to-pay test; no speculative mass-market build.

tasks.objective: Prepare one-command install/status/stop for proven runtime after motor gates pass.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh supported host can install/register/start/status/stop without per-worker manual prompts.

tasks.objective: Review whether Courier can remain standalone: cost structure, provider substitution, pilot economics and lock-in risk.
tasks.acceptance: Evidence-based standalone plan with no acquisition dependency.
